title: Text does not have the same size as Digital Clock text when both widgets are on the same panel
line: The Weather Report temperature in the panel is now the same size as the Digital Clock's time.
explanation: The weather widget fitted its temperature line into 0.7 of the panel height (0.9 in thin panels), factors copied from an old version of the Digital Clock. The clock now sets its time's font to 0.71 of the panel height whenever the time is on one line (date off or date beside the time), so the temperature came out smaller in thick panels (46 px: 12 vs 15 px digits; 60 px: 20 vs 22) and the 0.9 jump made it inconsistent in thin ones. The temperature now uses the clock's rule, min(0.71 x height, 3 x default font size), and only shrinks if the text is too wide.

commits.message:
applets/weather: size the panel temperature like the clock's time

The temperature was fitted into 0.7 or 0.9 of the panel height, which no
longer matches the digital clock, so it was smaller than a one-line time
in thick panels. Use the clock's rule instead: 0.71 of the panel height.

BUG: 447011

patches.diff:
From 29c9e6b2fdf3ded4aa372c62c672610a7578857a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 18:14:11 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/weather: size the panel temperature like the clock's
 time

The temperature was fitted into 0.7 or 0.9 of the panel height, which no
longer matches the digital clock, so it was smaller than a one-line time
in thick panels. Use the clock's rule instead: 0.71 of the panel height.

BUG: 447011
---
 applets/weather/qml/IconAndTextItem.qml | 13 ++++---------
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 9 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/IconAndTextItem.qml b/applets/weather/qml/IconAndTextItem.qml
index 684c9d4b6..411983254 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/IconAndTextItem.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/IconAndTextItem.qml
@@ -64,10 +64,11 @@ GridLayout {
                 family: label.font.family
                 weight: label.font.weight
                 italic: label.font.italic
-                pixelSize: iconAndTextRoot.vertical ? Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2 : 1024 // random "big enough" size - this is used as a max pixelSize by the fontSizeMode
+                // Same size as the digital clock's time when it is shown on its own
+                pixelSize: iconAndTextRoot.vertical ? Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 2 : Math.min(parent.height * 0.71, 3 * Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pixelSize)
             }
             minimumPixelSize: Math.round(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit / 2)
-            fontSizeMode: iconAndTextRoot.vertical ? Text.HorizontalFit : Text.VerticalFit
+            fontSizeMode: iconAndTextRoot.vertical ? Text.HorizontalFit : Text.FixedSize
             wrapMode: Text.NoWrap
 
             horizontalAlignment: Text.AlignHCenter
@@ -76,12 +77,6 @@ GridLayout {
                 leftMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
                 rightMargin: Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
             }
-            // These magic values are taken from the digital clock, so that the
-            // text sizes here are identical with various clock text sizes
-            height: {
-                const textHeightScaleFactor = (parent.height > 26) ? 0.7 : 0.9;
-                return Math.min (parent.height * textHeightScaleFactor, 3 * Kirigami.Theme.defaultFont.pixelSize);
-            }
             visible: false
 
             // pattern to reserve some constant space TODO: improve and take formatting/i18n into account
@@ -94,7 +89,7 @@ GridLayout {
 
             font {
                 weight: Font.Normal
-                pixelSize: 1024
+                pixelSize: iconAndTextRoot.vertical ? 1024 : sizehelper.font.pixelSize
             }
             minimumPixelSize: Math.round(Kirigami.Units.gridUnit / 2)
             fontSizeMode: Text.Fit
--
